title: Correct normal force at C
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the normal force at point C using Newton's second law for circular motion, yielding 6 N.

title: Correct final horizontal distance
description: Essential Criteria: The response must correctly compute the horizontal throw distance from point D, yielding 1.2 m.

title: Energy or work analysis on AB
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly apply the work-energy theorem or equivalent to find the speed at B, accounting for friction on the incline.

title: Kinematics on conveyor belt
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly determine the slider's acceleration on the belt using friction and find its speed at D.

title: Free-fall time calculation
description: Important Criteria: The response must correctly calculate the time to fall from height H - L1 sinθ to the ground using kinematic equations.

title: Velocity continuity at B-C
description: Optional Criteria: The response should note that speed is conserved from B to C due to the smooth, negligible-length arc.

title: Newton's third law application
description: Optional Criteria: The response should explicitly state that the pressure on the track equals the normal force by Newton's third law.

title: Sign error in circular motion
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response incorrectly sets up the force balance at C (e.g., mg - FN = mv²/R) leading to a wrong normal force.

title: Incorrect fall height
description: Pitfall Criteria: The response uses the wrong height (e.g., H instead of H - L1 sinθ) to calculate the free-fall time.
